# Tricky Addon for MySU

A WebUI to configure Tricky Store target.txt, OhMyKeymint, and TEESim target lists natively for MySU.

### Features
- Native MySU JS Bridge integration powered by `@mysu-org/mysu`
- Manage and update Tricky Store `target.txt` directly from MySU Manager WebUI
- Modern Material 3 UI with dark mode, live search, app icons, and batch selection
- Supports both legacy mode and Keybox extraction

### Upstream Project
Maintained upstream by [KOWX712](https://github.com/KOWX712/Tricky-Addon-Update-Target-List). Ported natively to MySU by [kelexine](https://github.com/kelexine).

releases.descriptionHTML:
Tricky Addon v5.0 for MySU

First official release natively ported from source for MySU.

  • Replaced legacy kernelsu-alt with native @mysu-org/mysu@3.0.2
  • Built with Material 3 WebUI tailored for MySU WebUI bridge
  • Added module.prop self-healing to maintain manager discovery
  • Supports dev.kelexine.mysu WebUI directly
